status: Executable candidate; numerically checked on declared FIT only; not a performance result.
scientific_object: Measured angular/relative-delay/receive-energy structure, separately for each real32-element panel.

competition.PAS: Per-frequency cosine across spatial/polarization bins, then average UE/frequency/points.
competition.PDP: Per-link cosine across delay bins, then average links/points.
competition.limitation: Measured single-TX/two-panels are not the original2-polarization x4-UE tensor; raw absolute-H NMSE is not transferred.

pas_cosine.operator: FFT2 over each actual8x4 array; power; cosine across32 direction bins at each frequency.
pas_cosine.rationale: Closest physical-layout adaptation of competition PAS, preserves every frequency.
pas_cosine.requires: A genuinely frequency-resolved prediction; no copying a broadband-only prediction across tones.

relative_pdp_cosine.operator: Each channel tensor independently referenced with one shared anchor for all32 elements per panel; IFFT then power; cosine across full relative-delay axis per receive element.
relative_pdp_cosine.rationale: Inherits competition PDP shape operator after explicitly removing unidentifiable common timing.
relative_pdp_cosine.allowed_claim: Relative profile shape, not absolute arrival time, physical first-path timing or unique true path recovery.

receive_energy_TV.caveat: Marginal only; cannot establish correct receive/delay pairing or separate fixed hardware response from propagation.

receive_delay_joint_TV.rationale: Distinguishes correct total receive energy from energy placed at the wrong relative delay/channel.

auxiliary.covariance_NMSE: Within-panel spatial correlation diagnostic; distinct from energy allocation.
auxiliary.frequency_correlation_MAE: Panel/per-beam frequency-structure diagnostic; not a replacement for direct relative PDP.
auxiliary.relative_CSI_power_MAE_db: Total measured signal strength versus a FIT-only panel reference; not dBm.
auxiliary.RMS_delay_spread: Deferred until FIT-fixed noise/window/unwrap rules are justified; moment sensitivity is not hidden by a direct profile score.
auxiliary.angle_delay_joint_spectrum: Needed if the paper claims correct direction-delay pairing; marginal PAS/PDP alone are insufficient.

reference.equivalence: H -> a*exp(j*phi)*exp(-j*2*pi*f*tau0)*H for common a,phi,tau0 within one calibrated panel.
reference.comparison_window: Entire centered FFT period; no adaptive peak crop or best-shift search.
reference.meaning: A mathematical reference modulo the delay period, not the physical first arrival.

aggregation: Average valid frequency/link cells within each position/panel; positions within each panel; then the two panels equally. Report panels separately.

invalid_policy.reference: Nonfinite rejected. Zero reference energy or numerically undefined timing counted; only reference determines excluded cells.
invalid_policy.prediction: Zero or undefined-timing prediction on a valid reference remains in the denominator: PAS/PDP zero, energy/joint TV one. No method-specific reference mask.

selection.reason: Do not replace missing absolute-H score with a new weighted winner score.
selection.previous_model_outputs: Not loaded or rescored. Any later use is development exploration because old checkpoints were selected by old objectives.
selection.future: Training/selection changes must be explicit; keep existing raw, prepared and result versions. North/TEST remain held out.

baseline_eligibility.full_channel: Eligible for both primary metrics and energy mechanisms if produced without query truth.
baseline_eligibility.broadband_only: Eligible only for declared broadband direction/beam auxiliary comparisons; no artificial phases or repeated-tone claims.
baseline_eligibility.energy_controls: Later include uniform and FIT-average allocation; no baseline scored in this stage.

implementation_boundary.measured_receive_head: One shared32-element log-amplitude vector per query/panel; same gain multiplies all candidate paths.
implementation_boundary.consequence: Not an equivalent implementation of the original port mechanism; metric changes alone do not restore that mechanism.
implementation_boundary.caution: Do not blindly invent UE/polarization ports or copy a path-specific receiver head without physical justification.
